newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government and unions opposed on issue of labour flexibility, and notably on plans to offer diploma qualifying internships to young jobseekers.

-- Four labour unions at state-owned telecommunications operator France Telecom accept agreement on work hours reduction and flexibility designed to improve competitivity ahead of a planned January 1998 French telecommunications deregulation. Chairman Michel Bon explains in an interview that agreement includes apprenticeship plans for a thousand young workers, and the opening of branch offices on Saturdays nationwide. It also includes shorter working hours and early retirement measures.
-- Paribas to sell banking subsidiary Credit du Nord to Societe Generale for an estimated 2.2 billion francs. Stock market welcomes sale.
